claims.quote: creditors get at least six months from the first published notice to file claims, and the estate cannot close before that period ends
A straightforward estate usually takes about 9 to 12 months from opening to closing.
If the estate has no real estate and its personal property totals $150,000 or less, for a death on or after August 15, 2025, a Small Estate Affidavit may be an option.
